cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I marked our bedroom floor with crosses like the builder. We wanted a home we made together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His crosses mark rotten boards to remove. You've marked the entire bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, making room for us. We can start where the bed will go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't sleep in there until it's repaired. We'll have to share the tent in the garden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then that's our first room. Bring both pillows; we can plan the bedroom with our heads together.

reason: Make the misunderstood copied act determine the same-holder Drive pursuit, preserve the useful original situation where possible, and give B4 specific causal material for A5.
